name: Blightbreaker raises Mercy's tick rate by 50% (period 3000 to 2000 ms) and doubles its cost
contract: Owner ruling O-24 (2026-11-22), Sun Cleric ADR 0031: Blightbreaker 707433 reads 'Increases the tick rate of Mercy by $s1%, but increases its mana cost by $s2%.' Effect 0 is aura 108 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (19) at -50 and effect 1 aura 108 SPELLMOD_COST (14) at +100, both on EffectSpellClassMask [32, 0, 0] in family 33 (Mercy 504848's SpellFamilyFlags word 0). Mercy's effect 0 is aura 23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL of Mercy Proc 503650 with a 3000 ms amplitude, DurationIndex 29 (12000 ms) and SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD. The ruling keeps the duration and adds 50% to the tick rate: the period becomes 3000 x 100 / 150 = 2000 ms (the stock -50% period modifier gave 1500). aura_ascension_sun_cleric_mercy sets the amplitude before the engine applies the modifier (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:709 then :725), so the modifier query still reads the DBC -50% while the applied aura reads 2000. Each tick casts 503650 from the aura's holder (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, no explicit target), so the holder's 503650 cast count over the whole aura counts the ticks. Control arm: the caster without Blightbreaker, period 3000 and its tick count; Blightbreaker arm: period 2000 and its tick count over the same 12000 ms duration; the cost stays doubled. The arms run one after the other and each count is taken relative to a snapshot after the other caster's Mercy expired, because Mercy chains to nearby allies (sun-cleric-mercy) and a chained copy would tick on the other player too.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Blightbreaker's passive aura is on the caster
Control's Mercy tick modifier is untouched
Blightbreaker's DBC period modifier stays installed (-50% in the modifier query)
No Mercy is on control before its own cast
control's Mercy Proc casts before its own Mercy
control's Mercy expires after its 12000 ms duration
Control's Mercy ticks over its whole duration
No Mercy is on breaker before its own cast
breaker's Mercy Proc casts before its own Mercy
breaker's Mercy expires after its 12000 ms duration
Blightbreaker caster's Mercy ticks over the same duration
